boards.name: Idealist
boards.notes: Footer language switcher offers English and Español. Homepage describes employers and groups posting jobs. A menu lists API and CSR Partners, but the pages behind them could not be opened (404 on guessed URLs), so api_status and partner_program are not confirmed. Site describes itself as a 501(c)(3) based in New York and says it merged with VolunteerMatch; no parent company is named.

boards.name: Japan Dev
boards.notes: Header menu links to a Japanese version; page metadata declares English. About page lists an office address in Kawasaki, Japan, with no headquarters statement. Employer pricing, API and partner program are not stated on the pages read. Site says its data is gathered from public sources or contributed by users.

boards.name: Rozee.pk
boards.notes: Footer states the site is a division of Naseeb Networks, Inc. Language switcher lists English with Urdu and Simplified Chinese alternates. Employer products are linked but no prices are shown. Job posting is by the employer's own post form; no feed or API is described.

sources.title: Footer copyright
sources.quote: A Division of Naseeb Networks, Inc.

boards.name: Flexa
boards.notes: Pricing page describes integration of candidate profiles with applicant tracking systems and lists ATS logos. Employer pricing, language options and headquarters are not stated on the pages read. The /about page returned 404.

sources.title: Pricing page ATS section
sources.quote: Seamlessly integrate your Flexa profile with your ATS and consolidate your applications

boards.name: CVMarket.lt
boards.notes: Language switcher offers LT and EN; the page itself is in Lithuanian. Employer section links to VIP job ads and services, with no prices shown. Headquarters and parent company are not stated; a Lithuanian phone number appears but no address.

boards.name: SeekOut
boards.notes: Pricing page lists per-seat pricing, a 14-day free trial and enterprise pricing by quote; no list prices are shown. ATS integration is a listed feature on some tiers. The homepage fetch returned embedded instructions, which were ignored. Language options, parent company and API status were not stated on the pages read.
